setup: Build empty ephemeral and durable root Parallel scopes through TryBuild and Build.
assertion: TryBuild reports SFE-AUTH-BRANCH-004 at Parallel and Build throws WorkflowDefinitionException with identical diagnostics; no empty merge runs.
expectedRed: Exact root Parallel builders and diagnostic are absent.

setup: Complete and fail branches/items under both joins.
assertion: Only typed success and failure variants exist; cancellation is an ancestor transition rather than an outcome variant.
expectedRed: Final closed outcome families are absent.

setup: Fail multiple branches/items in reverse completion order under WhenAll.
assertion: Merge is suppressed and SFE-JOIN-FAILED Causes remain authored-ordinal/item-index ordered.
expectedRed: Exact ordered normalized join failure is absent.

setup: Race cancellation, termination, and CompleteWithin against active branches/items.
assertion: The winning ancestor terminal commit fences work and suppresses WhenAll and WhenAllOutcomes merges without sibling-cancellation semantics.
expectedRed: Final ancestor merge fencing is absent.

setup: Select an empty finite ForEach snapshot under both joins.
assertion: No item is admitted and the chosen merge runs once with an empty ordered list.
expectedRed: Final root durable ForEach contract is absent.

setup: Exercise exact MaxItems, oversized count, mutable source, restart before/after snapshot commit, and item-state codec failure.
assertion: Bound/codec validation precedes partial admission; one detached indexed snapshot replays without reselection.
expectedRed: Finite snapshot and bound replay are provisional.

setup: Run root Parallel and ForEach at a path-token ceiling of one with branches/items that park and resume.
assertion: Parent releases before admission, children queue by ordinal/index, parked scopes release tokens, and parent reacquires only for merge/continuation so progress cannot deadlock.

setup: Vary host path ceiling and ForEach MaxConcurrency while items park.
assertion: Admission uses the lower limit; parked items release path tokens but retain admitted-item slots until terminal.

setup: Crash with running and parked items, then restart under a different host ceiling.
assertion: No host slots are persisted; terminal items stay terminal and unfinished items re-enter admission in item-index order.
